verses.english: Dwelling at the Root of a Tree
“Mendicants, there are these five who dwell at the root of a tree.

verses.pali: Mandattā momūhattā rukkhamūliko hoti …pe… idamatthitaṁyeva nissāya rukkhamūliko hoti.
verses.english: One may dwell at the root of a tree because of stupidity … corrupt wishes … madness … because it is praised by the Buddhas … or for the sake of having few wishes …
These are the five who dwell at the root of a tree.”
